name: Sketch-based Transfer Function Editing
definition: A sketch-based interface for volume rendering that allows users to explicitly draw, tweak, locally refine, or globally define intensity- and gradient-based transfer functions using a multi-touch tabletop.
summary: Sketch-based Transfer Function Editing is a multi-touch interface for designing volume rendering transfer functions via direct manipulation gestures, distinguishing itself by focusing on global domain manipulation rather than spatial position.
